purpose: Test whether observer/telemetry instrumentation can see target-aware metadata or perturb the exact precommitted bytes consumed by discovery. This extends orchestration discipline only; it does not create a new discovery mechanism.

observer_effect_translation.decoherence_analogue: observer-dependent candidate bytes or candidate result
observer_effect_translation.delayed_reveal: provenance and historical labels disclosed only after candidate hashes are frozen
observer_effect_translation.important_note: Classical experimental-design analogy only; no claim of quantum computation or quantum behavior.

blind_payload_contract.byte_isolation_rule: Candidate consumes a fresh decode of immutable precommitted blind bytes. Observer consumes a separate fresh decode and can never receive the candidate's mutable object.

hostile_copy_rule: HOSTILE_COPY_OBSERVER deliberately mutates only its private decoded copy. Candidate input SHA and candidate output must remain identical to NO_OBSERVER.

representation_regression.purpose: Retest existing P11-style invariance only as a harness regression, not as new authority.

protocol: Freeze blind payload bytes and transform seeds before any observer runs.
Assert target metadata canary is absent from candidate-visible bytes.
Run NO_OBSERVER, READ_ONLY_OBSERVER, and HOSTILE_COPY_OBSERVER from independent decodes of the same bytes.
Require identical candidate-input SHA across observer modes.
Require identical candidate result across observer modes.
Inverse-map disguised-view candidates and retest representation coherence as an existing-authority regression.
Freeze candidate hash manifest before target metadata/provenance reveal.
Reveal provenance only after freeze and require the freeze hash to remain unchanged.
Run an unsafe shared-mutable-object negative control and require contamination detection.
Treat all synthetic/current-corpus executions as calibration only.
future_use_rule: When genuinely new source-bound raw provenance appears and is frozen under then-current authority, this diagnostic may accompany the scientific gate as an anti-leak/noninterference check. It cannot itself provide solver, carrier, universality, or tractability authority.
falsification_priority: Prefer detecting observer contamination or information leakage over obtaining a PASS.
